item.title: Spying on Governments with Zero Lines of Malware: A Custom SoftEther Bridge in Webworm’s Toolkit
item.description: Introduction For a threat actor, the perfect malware is one they don’t have to write, and already does all they need. One example of this is shown by the China-aligned APT known as Webworm, which has been known to deploy the open-source SoftEther VPN into the networks of compromised governmental organizations to maintain low-profile, long-term access. item.title: What Is Preemptive MDR? A Guide For Security Leaders
item.description: When an MDR provider contains a compromised endpoint, your team needs to know whether the weakness that enabled the attack exists elsewhere and who is responsible for addressing it. Without that follow-through, the immediate incident may be resolved while another attacker still has a way in. Preemptive managed detection and response (MDR) is Rapid7's approach to connecting exposure context, threat intelligence, AI-assisted investigation, and human expertise. item.title: ZDI-26-1038: (0Day) (Pwn2Own) United Chargers Grizzl-E Smart 40A OCPP UpdateFirmware Out-Of-Bounds Write Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
item.description: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of United Chargers Grizzl-E Smart 40A EV chargers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 7.5. The following CVEs are assigned: CVE-2026-131813.
